## Summary
Ariyan Khan is a freelance video editor based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, helping YouTube creators,
brands, founders, coaches, educators, podcasters, healthcare professionals, and agencies grow
through high-retention video content. He specializes in four core editing styles — talking head
YouTube videos, cinematic documentaries, short-form social content (TikTok, Instagram Reels,
YouTube Shorts), and animated map/geopolitical visuals — plus audience-specific services for
founders, coaches, corporate teams, podcasters, healthcare professionals, and fitness creators.
5M+ total views generated for clients, 314+ satisfied clients, and an average 60%+ audience
retention rate on edited videos. Every project includes 4 rounds of free revisions and an
on-time delivery guarantee (partial or full refund if a missed deadline is Ariyan's fault).

## Core Services

### Talking Head Video Editing
- High-retention edits for YouTube creators, coaches, educators, and founders
- Includes: smart cuts and pacing, captions, B-roll, color grading, audio cleanup, motion graphics
- Turnaround: varies by length and complexity — discussed per project
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/talking-head-video-editing.html

### Documentary Video Editing
- Professional long-form documentary editing with cinematic quality
- Includes: narrative structure, interview assembly, cinematic color grade, sound mix
- Delivery: 4K export, 4 revision rounds included, 7-10 day delivery
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/documentary-video-editing.html

### Short Form Video Editing
- Scroll-stopping edits for vertical platforms
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
- Includes: strong hooks, fast-paced cuts, animated captions, sound design, 9:16 delivery
- Turnaround: usually within 24 hours
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/short-form-video-editing.html

### Map Animation & Geopolitical Visuals
- Cinematic animated maps for visual storytelling
- Includes: country highlights, route animations, zoom transitions, geopolitical context
- Best for: documentary makers, history & geography YouTube channels, explainer videos
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/map-animation-video-editing.html

## Tools & Software
- Primary: Adobe Premiere Pro
- Color Grading: DaVinci Resolve
- Motion Graphics: Adobe After Effects
- Audio: Adobe Audition, Premiere Pro audio tools

## Editing Process
1. The Brief — Understanding your vision, audience, and goals. A clear brief is written before editing begins.
2. Rough Cut — Building the story structure, finding the strongest moments, setting pacing and narrative flow.
3. Fine Cut + Graphics — Precision editing with motion graphics, captions, B-roll, lower thirds, and transitions.
4. Color + Audio — Cinematic color grading, professional audio mix, noise reduction, and music.
5. Delivery + Revisions — Export in required format, platform-optimized. Source files available on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I request revisions?
Every project includes 4 rounds of free revisions as standard. Additional revision rounds
beyond that are available for a small fee.

### What if delivery is late?
Ariyan offers an on-time delivery guarantee: if final delivery is late for reasons within his
control (not delays caused by late assets, an incomplete brief, or client-requested changes),
the client is entitled to a partial refund reflecting the delay, up to a full refund if the
project is cancelled as a result.

### What is your delivery time?
Delivery time depends on the length and complexity of the footage and which service it is.
Short-form edits are usually delivered within 24 hours, documentaries take 7-10 days, and
talking-head or audience-specific edits are scoped per project.

### Can you match my existing editing style?
Yes. Send a reference video and Ariyan will match the color grade, pacing, captions, motion
graphics, and overall feel to keep it consistent with your existing channel or brand.

### Do you provide source files?
Yes, Adobe Premiere Pro project files are available upon request for an additional fee. Final
video is delivered in any required format — 4K, 1080p, vertical (9:16), square, or custom
aspect ratios.

### How do I get started?
Fill out the contact form at https://ariyankhan.com/#contact with your project details.

## Free Tools
- Map Maker: https://ariyankhan.com/map-maker/
  Free, browser-only map generator for creators and teachers. Highlight countries by clicking or
  searching (aliases like UK/USA/Burma work), up to six colour groups with labels, eight projections
  including an orthographic globe, region presets (Europe, South Asia, Middle East…), "zoom to selection",
  16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:3 / 21:9 canvases, style presets, transparent background, graticule, labels.
  Exports PNG at 1×/2×/4× (up to 8K on 16:9) or SVG; a share link encodes the whole map. Borders are
  Natural Earth (public domain, de facto boundaries; 1:110m by default, optional 1:50m with 241
  territories). Built by Ariyan Khan, who does map animation for YouTube channels professionally.
- AI Metadata Remover: https://ariyankhan.com/ai-metadata-remover/
  Free, browser-only tool that removes C2PA / JUMBF Content Credentials, XMP, IPTC, EXIF (camera, GPS,
  software), JPEG comments, PNG text chunks (Stable Diffusion "parameters", ComfyUI "prompt"/"workflow"),
  WebP EXIF/XMP/C2PA chunks and hidden trailing data from JPG, PNG and WebP images. The file container is
  rewritten and pixel data is copied byte-for-byte, so quality is untouched and the file is usually smaller.
  Nothing is uploaded — there is no server endpoint, no account and no quota; batch, drag-and-drop and
  clipboard paste are supported. One click removes everything; the colour profile is kept. To see what a
  file holds before cleaning it, including which AI generator left a signature (ChatGPT/DALL·E, Google
  Gemini/Imagen, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Microsoft Designer), use AI Image
  Checker, below. Honest limits: it cannot remove
  pixel-level watermarks such as Google SynthID, cannot fool pixel-based AI detectors and handles still
  images only (no video). Built by Ariyan Khan for his own thumbnail / B-roll workflow.
- AI Image Checker: https://ariyankhan.com/ai-image-checker/
- Travel Map (countries, states and regions visited): https://ariyankhan.com/travel-map/
  Free, browser-only companion to the remover: it reads an image’s metadata and reports what it says about
  how the image was made (AI generators named in it, C2PA Content Credentials, the IPTC AI source type,
  Stable Diffusion prompts, camera, date and GPS). Nothing is uploaded; a clean result is not proof an image is real.
- Puzzle – Train Your Brain (daily brain training and arrow puzzle game): https://ariyankhan.com/puzzle/
  Free brain-training game that plays in the browser; no download, and solo play needs no account.
  Daily Training is four short rounds every day on 247 public-domain paintings from The Metropolitan
  Museum of Art's Open Access collection: Restore the Canvas (memorise a painting, then put its 9 to 25
  pieces back), The Forgery (spot the patches of a forged copy that are mirrored, recoloured or moved),
  Gallery Memory (re-hang paintings in the order they hung) and The Curator's Eye (pick which of four
  close-ups came from the painting). Each round is scored 0-100 and gets harder or easier with your
  scores; the day's average is the Brain Score, and playing every day builds a streak. The arrow logic
  puzzle: tap an arrow to send it off the board if its path is clear, a blocked tap costs a heart
  (four on Easy and Normal, fewer higher up). Nearly 300 boards shaped like all 197 countries, with animal, bird, landmark and picture boards
  between them, make a world tour from your home country; hints, difficulty from Easy to Master that
  follows your play, and country facts (capital, population, region) on every country cleared. Optional
  Google sign-in adds online matches with friends and a weekly league. No in-app purchases; any
  advertisement is optional and rewarded. Solo boards work offline once loaded.
